text: Why does the weight on a pressure cooker dance?
The heavy weight sits on a thin pipe in the lid and plugs it, so the steam is trapped.
As the water boils, the steam pushes up on the weight, harder and harder.
When that push beats the weight, it lifts, and a puff of steam escapes.
The pressure drops a little, so the weight falls back. Up, down, again and again.
So the weight sets the top pressure.
